name: TaxProper
long_description: TaxProper is an enterprise SaaS solution that acquires real-time property tax data, encodes local tax rules, and contains all of the operational workflows associated with property tax management. Our core products automate property tax payments, forecast future property tax liability, and help large real estate operators manage their property tax appeals.
one_liner: TaxProper helps large Real Estate owners manage their property taxes.

founders.title: Founder
founders.founder_bio:
Tom is the co-founder of FullSeam (W26). FullSeam automates work for corporate accounting teams. 

He previously co-founded TaxProper (S19), the leading property tax software for institutional real estate investors, which was acquired by Opendoor (NASDAQ: OPEN) for 8-figures in 2022.

He advised the Mayor of Chicago and was appointed by Illinois Governor JB Pritzker to oversee a $700m/year state agency. He has a BA from UIUC and an MSc from Oxford, where he was a Rhodes Scholar.
